description: A dim living room in loose, heavy brushstrokes. In the foreground a hand painted in dark red-brown grips a silver-grey pistol-shaped object, and lettering on its side reads 'ZENITH' over 'FLASH-MATIC'. Behind it stands a wooden cabinet television with a bright, static-filled screen, beside a table lamp and drawn curtains. A small sparkle logo sits in the bottom-right corner.
reason: The gun-shaped remote has the printed words 'ZENITH' and 'FLASH-MATIC' on its side. Paint the device without any lettering; the sparkle logo in the corner is fine.
